words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live round.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 100 (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 100 (open, price, submit).

As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that Data check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true; Data check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true; Data check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true.
